title: Logger Rate Limiter
prompt: Design a logger system that receives messages with timestamps. Each message should be printed only if it was not printed in the last 10 seconds.
complexity_target: Track only the last printed timestamp per message.

title: Car Pooling
prompt: You are driving a vehicle with a fixed capacity. Given a list of trips where each trip is [numPassengers, from, to], return true if it is possible to complete all trips without exceeding capacity.
complexity_target: Use event-based accumulation rather than checking each trip against every other one.
edge_case_hints: drop-off and pickup at same point

title: Alien Dictionary Order
prompt: You are given a sorted list of words from an unknown alphabet. Infer one valid character ordering. Return an empty string if the ordering is invalid.
complexity_target: Build only the necessary graph edges and detect invalid prefixes early.
